contexts.text: Gross and dense falsities are described in the Word by owls, and ravens; by owls, because they live in the darkness of night... as in, The owl and the raven shall dwell therein (); where it treats of the Jewish Church, that there are nothing but Falsities there, which are described by the owl and the raven.
The internal of the Babylonish worship is described by... the daughters of the owl, etc. ().
Man... is like an owl, which, because it flies in the shade of night, supposes itself to be in the light; but when in the light of day, it supposes itself to be in the shade. Explained.

Such Spirits, and hence such men, see like owls, clearly by night and obscurely by day; that is, falsities clearly, and truths obscurely; and thence the things of the world clearly; and obscurely, if at all, the things of Heaven.
The cormorant, bittern, owl, and raven () = the genera of falsity which come forth when the Divine truths which are in the Word are made of no account.

They who have used the sciences (or knowledges) as means for annihilating the things of faith, have completely destroyed their Intellectual, and see in thick darkness like owls, falsity for truth, and evil for good.
The ziim and ijim, and the daughters of the owl, shall dwell there () = evils and falsities, thus the things which are of death, within.
The Angels liken such (naturalists) to owls, which see in the darkness, and nothing in the light. DP 117:end. ISB 10:4.
The falsities of evil are darkness, and also correspond thereto; and therefore those who are in them... shun the things which are in light like owls.
As with owls and bats, which see objects in the night [and] evening as clearly as other birds see them in the day; for their eyes are formed for the reception of their own light.
Fatuous light is the light of the confirmation of falsity; and this light corresponds to the light in which are owls and bats, to whom darkness is light, and light darkness. From experience.
Those in that abyss... and those who are like them, are called owls and bats. TCR 162:3.
Those who are in falsified truths and adulterated goods appear like owls and bats.
All such... at last acquire a sight like that of owls, and see in darkness.
The thoughts of these are represented by night-owls, and their speech by screech-owls.
An owl is in fatuous light; for within its eyes there is the cupidity of pursuing and devouring birds; and this light causes its eyes to see in the night time, exactly as with cats...
Those who see by confirmations are not unlike owls, which see light in the shade of night; and by day see the sun and its rays as thick darkness.

By the daughters of the owl, etc. () are signified those who know truths and goods from the memory only, and do not understand and perceive them. These speak truth without any idea of truth, depending solely upon others.
These corporeal and merely natural concupiscences, from which flow forth falsities and evils of every kind, are signified by the owl, etc. ().
By the daughters of the owl () are signified Falsities.

When reputation, glory, and gain, dominate, Heaven cannot inflow with its light, and open the sight, and illustrate; and therefore they see like owls, moles, and bats, in the darkness, according to... ; (where) the daughters of the owl = affections of falsity.
By the daughters of the owl () are signified sensuous affections; for the Sensuous is affection with truths, and sees them in darkness, as owls see objects in the night.

The devastation of all good and truth is signified by an abode of dragons, and a court of the daughters of the owl (). Owls = those who see falsities for truths; and their daughters = the concupiscences of falsifying truths.
Lamentation over devasted truth is signified by to make a mourning like the daughters of the owl ().
Falsified truths are the daughters of the owl ().
There are many kinds of falsities... named in the Word: as screech-owls... night-owls, horned-owls, etc.

As mourning relates to falsity, it is said, I will make a mourning like the daughters of the owl (). The daughters of the owl those who are in Falsities and their pleasantnesses. Owls = falsities, because they see in darkness and not in the light.
